method: Assistant spot check of 12 randomly selected labels after the first automatic screen, seed 20261012; this is not a human audit.
finding: Some descriptions were overly broad or inaccurate despite passing the small-model screen.
response: Rechecked every one of the 154 nonduplicate screened descriptions with a separate larger model; retained 88.

remaining_examples.issue: Core possessive usage is supported, but the label incorrectly calls possessive determiners definite articles.
Held-out text supports marine coral/reef content; the tropical qualifier is not explicit.

conclusion: Automatic review reduces obvious errors but does not establish fully validated semantics; results remain exploratory.
